baseline: Exact frozen raw-text TF-IDF plus Logistic Regression baseline
selection_rule: Prefer a one-lever variant only when dev error transitions and the paired superficial-perturbation check support its mechanism. Otherwise retain raw text. Do not select from held-out.

variants.name: raw_text_control
variants.hypothesis: The unchanged frozen baseline provides the required control and may already be invariant to several surface forms because its default token pattern lowercases words and ignores much punctuation and emoji.

variants.name: normalize_urls_placeholder
variants.hypothesis: Collapsing unstable domains and paths while preserving URL presence will reduce memorization of URL fragments and improve robustness, with little loss of disaster-semantic evidence.

variants.name: normalize_mentions_placeholder
variants.hypothesis: Collapsing user handles will remove identity-specific vocabulary while preserving the fact that a mention occurred, improving robustness with little visible-score cost.

variants.name: strip_hashtag_marker
variants.hypothesis: Preserving the hashtag word but removing its marker should retain topical meaning and make hash-mark formatting irrelevant; the frozen tokenizer may already make this prediction-equivalent.

variants.name: normalize_punctuation_to_space
variants.lever: replace every Unicode punctuation character with a space
variants.hypothesis: Canonical punctuation boundaries may reduce stylistic noise, but apostrophes, underscores, and URL punctuation can also affect useful token structure, so error movement may be mixed.

variants.name: unicode_casefold
variants.lever: apply Unicode casefold before the frozen lowercasing vectorizer
variants.hypothesis: Unicode casefolding should make casing perturbations harmless and mostly match the already-lowercased control, with possible differences only for non-ASCII case mappings.

variants.name: normalize_emoji_placeholder
variants.hypothesis: Preserving emoji presence as one token may capture affect while preventing particular glyphs from being brittle; because the frozen word tokenizer ignores most emoji, visible movement may be small.

paired_robustness_perturbations.normalize_urls_placeholder: replace URLs with a deterministic unseen URL
paired_robustness_perturbations.normalize_mentions_placeholder: replace handles with a deterministic unseen handle
paired_robustness_perturbations.normalize_punctuation_to_space: replace Unicode punctuation with an alternate punctuation mark
paired_robustness_perturbations.normalize_emoji_placeholder: replace emoji spans with a different emoji
